hook: Your octopus tastes with its arms

scenes.line: You taste food with your tongue, right? Boring. An octopus?
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of an octopus arm extending through dark blue water, dozens of translucent suckers visible in sharp detail, each sucker catching bioluminescent light

scenes.line: Each sucker on an octopus arm has thousands of chemoreceptor
scenes.visual_prompt: Macro cross-section illustration of a single sucker, glowing neural pathways branching through tissue, golden chemoreceptor nodes firing with light

scenes.line: It's like having taste buds scattered across your entire body,
scenes.visual_prompt: An octopus arm unfurling across a dark seafloor, suckers lighting up like a constellation, each glow representing a taste receptor firing simultaneously

scenes.line: So when it grabs prey, it already knows exactly what
scenes.visual_prompt: An octopus arm wrapping around a small fish, suckers clamping down, geometric light patterns pulsing from sucker to neural centers

cta: Would you rather have an octopus's distributed sense of taste or keep your centralized one?
